_note: Hyperparameters extracted once from diabetes_global_xgboost.pkl (v1.0.0, Optuna-tuned) so retraining never needs to unpickle. Verified 03 Nov 2026: fitting XGBClassifier(**xgb_params) on the historical train split reproduces the production .ubj exactly (max |Δscore| = 0) and the 5-fold OOF PR-AUC 0.4384 / ROC-AUC 0.8316 in model_metadata.json.

historical_dataset.sha256_note: Reference copy used for verification. A different checksum (e.g. CRLF line endings) only triggers a warning; the locked-test check is decisive.

derived_artifacts.risk_reference: np.quantile of predicted scores on the model's own training rows (p50, p75, p90, p95, p99) + max
derived_artifacts.capacity_config: locked test, K = ceil(n_test x capacity), rows ranked by score descending
derived_artifacts.calibration: sklearn.calibration.calibration_curve on the locked test, 10 quantile bins, no recalibration
derived_artifacts.shap_background: X_train.sample(500, random_state=42) from the historical train split; reused unchanged
